summary: Sanity ignores give existing content time to adapt to new tests; new content shouldn't use them, and ignores must be removed once the code is fixed or an unnecessary-ignore error is reported.
questions: Can I add a sanity ignore for my new module?
Why do I get an unnecessary ignore error?

answer_card.title: When to ignore sanity errors
answer_card.answer_md: Fix sanity issues where you can. Ignore entries exist so **existing** content can catch up with newer tests; new content should not use them. Once fixed, remove the ignore, or you'll get an "unnecessary ignore" error, which prevents regressions.
